description: The 'Inventory' tab button should lead to an overview page presenting options for 'Inventory', 'Invoices', and 'Delivery Notes'.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking the 'Inventory' tab navigates to a new overview screen.
The overview screen displays clear options for 'Inventory', 'Invoices', and 'Delivery Notes'.

feature: Invoice and Delivery Note Management UI
description: Admin users should be able to view and filter invoices and delivery notes by month, year, and dealer.
acceptance_criteria: Navigating to 'Invoices' displays a list of invoices.
Navigating to 'Delivery Notes' displays a list of delivery notes.
Admin can filter invoice/delivery note lists by month, year, and dealer.
Filtering results are displayed correctly based on selected criteria.

description: New permissions for 'invoices:view' and 'delivery_notes:view' (or similar) should be defined and assigned to the Admin role.
acceptance_criteria: Admin role has access to new invoice and delivery note features.
Non-admin roles do not have access to new invoice and delivery note features unless explicitly granted.
The application correctly enforces permissions for these new routes.

description: All parts of the application UI should correctly reflect the selected language from settings, with no remaining hardcoded strings.
acceptance_criteria: Changing the language in settings updates all visible UI text.
All navigation titles, button labels, and content text are localized.
No untranslated text strings are visible in the UI after a language switch.

description: The system should allow for the management of 'top groups' or categories for inventory products.
acceptance_criteria: Users with appropriate permissions can define and manage product categories.
Inventory items can be assigned to product categories.
The UI reflects the categorization of products.

description: On an order detail page, there should be a direct link to the associated dealer/supplier's details.
acceptance_criteria: An order detail page displays a clickable link to the supplier.
Clicking the supplier link navigates to a supplier detail page.
The supplier detail page displays relevant information about the supplier.

description: During the goods receipt process, newly delivered products must be added to the current inventory or update existing product quantities.
acceptance_criteria: Performing a goods receipt for a new product adds it to inventory.
Performing a goods receipt for an existing product updates its quantity in inventory.
The inventory view reflects the changes after a goods receipt.
